breaking.change: Removed -og-meta. A full-screen vignette, tint or material overlay is now its own element, <og-overlay effect="…">, with the same grammar; its strength is still the element's opacity.
breaking.fix: Replace an element styled with -og-meta: <value> by <og-overlay id="…" effect="<value>"></og-overlay> and keep its opacity (and any opacity animation) in CSS. A material parameter that came from var() comes from a bound attribute instead: effect={$fx}, the store holding the whole value.

added.summary: A full-screen overlay element: vignette [<colour>], tint <colour> or material <material>, drawn at the element's opacity and never taking input; og.load.document loads the ui-material asset its effect names.
